name: hangel
description: Find volunteering opportunities, plan NGO events and volunteer calls, scan open grant and funding calls, and shop for donations on hangel, a Turkiye-based social impact platform. Uses hangel's read-only public MCP server.
suggestedPrompts: What environmental volunteering opportunities are open right now?
Which grant and funding calls for youth organisations are open now? Sort them by deadline.
Show running shoes on hangel Market, starting with the highest donation rate.
